class.name: CSGModifierContext
class.brief_description: Provides access to generated CSG vertex data while a modifier is running.
class.description: Passed to [method CSGModifier._process] while a CSG shape is rebuilding. Vertex arrays use triangle order and contain [method get_vertex_count] elements. The context is only valid for the duration of the modifier call and should not be retained.

method.name: clear_custom
method.description: Removes the custom vertex data at [param channel]. Valid channels are [code]0[/code] through [code]3[/code].

method.name: get_colors
method.description: Returns vertex colors in triangle order, or an empty array if no color channel exists.

method.name: get_custom
method.description: Returns custom vertex values at [param channel] in triangle order, or an empty array if the channel does not exist.

method.name: get_custom_format
method.description: Returns the storage format used by custom [param channel].

method.name: get_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the number of triangle vertices available to this modifier.

method.name: get_vertices
method.description: Returns generated vertex positions in triangle order.

method.name: has_colors
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the brush has vertex colors.

method.name: set_colors
method.description: Sets vertex colors. [param colors] must contain exactly [method get_vertex_count] values.

method.name: set_custom
method.description: Sets custom vertex data. [param values] must contain exactly [method get_vertex_count] values.

method.name: set_custom_format
method.description: Sets the storage [param format] used by custom [param channel].
